page.notes: The Greek quotation from Eusebius (Hist. Eccl. 8.7) is set small and is hard to read; its four lines are marked illegible, and the one visible fragment is uncertain. The Greek word after "Ethnicis" is uncertain (read as θηριομάχοις). "6." and the other numbers opening the paragraphs are kept as printed. "homini" is set as printed and may be a misreading of "hominis" or "hominibus". "omni-" / "bus," is one word split at the line end. The paragraph starting "Idem iudicium" runs on to the next page.
